init.title: Wanjiale Advanced Options
init.description: A model template describes the template capability, which may differ from the real device (e.g. the template exposes zero-cold-water points while the device never raises the feature bit). Force-enable a feature that was not detected, or force-disable a mis-detected one. The integration reloads automatically after saving.

data.enable_control_rights: Enable multi-client control-rights preemption (off by default)

data_description.enable_control_rights: When enabled, the login phone number is used to claim the device control right before each command (mirrors the official app's multi-client exclusion). Keep it off if your model does not check control rights.
data_description.feature_force_on: Create entities for these features even if they were not detected.
data_description.feature_force_off: Never create entities for these features, even if the model template declares support.
